summary: Admit the official bounded single-order 5Post status lookup through the reviewed runtime.

impacts.evidence: The existing registry resolves the account from authenticated tenant scope before invoking the tracker.
Only normalized status, provider order identity, partner tracking reference and UTC timestamp cross the host boundary.
The existing generic tracking route now admits 5Post through the registry.
No event envelope or event payload changes.
The existing fivepost LogisticsTracker is composed into the builtin runtime.
The read uses existing shipment and operation boundaries without new persistence.
Fixed-host HTTPS, SecretProvider callback scope, response bounds and identity matching remain mandatory.
The operation is read-only and does not alter the approval policy boundary.
No privileged mutation or audit schema change is introduced.
Exactly one order is requested and duplicate/mismatched provider responses fail closed.
The transport uses only the official 5Post API host and does not admit callbacks.
The shared HTTP timeout, response-size and retry-after handling remains in force.
Removing the fivepost registry branch or support capability immediately closes the read.
Deterministic JWT and single-order status tests verify the official route and boundary.
